latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the reviser stage. The single native Goal passed the binding guard and was completed after the required outputs were saved.

- [final.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/A-F02-R0/run/A-F02-R0/stages/reviser/final.md) — complete proposal, plan-clause dispositions, and critique responses.
- [source-map.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/A-F02-R0/run/A-F02-R0/stages/reviser/source-map.json) and [sources/index.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/A-F02-R0/run/A-F02-R0/stages/reviser/sources/index.md) — preserved source IDs and navigable evidence.
- [native-goal-active.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/A-F02-R0/run/A-F02-R0/stages/reviser/native-goal-active.json) and [native-goal-terminal.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/A-F02-R0/run/A-F02-R0/stages/reviser/native-goal-terminal.json) — activation and completion responses.

The revision adds a restart and reconciliation protocol for MI-01, while clearly marking it unimplemented and unvalidated. Its database limits reflect SQLite’s documented transaction and writer behavior; filesystem recovery still requires testing on the museum’s target systems. [SQLite transaction documentation](https://www.sqlite.org/lang_transaction.html), [SQLite atomic commit](https://www.sqlite.org/atomiccommit.html) The DROID branch SHA remains unresolved; the release page identifies a release separately from its moving development branch. [DROID release page](https://github.com/digital-preservation/droid/releases/tag/6.9.13)
